summary: Legend Biotech Corp filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 7,700,000 American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing two ordinary shares. The public price is $29.35 per ADS, raising approximately $226.0 million in gross proceeds, with net proceeds of about $212.4 million after underwriting discounts. The underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,155,000 ADSs. Settlement is on a T+2 basis. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other event-driven category.
